adopted_semantics: Add parent_population_summary as a role distinct from both the current directory and an unexplained external reference.
A complete per-episode enumeration may bind a parent population when retained members match bit for bit, every extreme matches exactly and moments meet the separately justified pooled tolerance.
Reuse of the identified parent reference is the expected operation for the scoped check_stats_validity/generate_stats invocation; recomputing only the five-file subset is not a justified correction.
Author intent for carrying the parent reference into the subset and inference-time checkpoint-versus-dataset precedence remain separately unresolved.

parent_population_evidence.retention: shared immutable private reference; not refetched or copied into Git

separation: Expected decisions remain in the evaluation contract. The producer consumes evidence and declared obligations, not this contract or its expected_reference_decisions object.
